question: Which COF definition?
verdict: Use COF_first10s: it follows the adhesion law best among the definitions (P1 R² +0.36, P2 +0.23; end-of-run COF +0.08) with signal-to-noise 2.2; the instrument mean reads 13 % low and its ratio to ours falls with frequency (r = -0.70).

question: Which wear measure?
verdict: Use the most-worn valid location with robust levelling: 16 runs measurable with an LOD, replicate SD 0.07 dex, Archard R² P1 +0.29 / P2 +0.15; the old mean-of-locations, plain-levelling measure gives 0.34 dex and R² +0.08 / +0.01. Exponents: V ~ L^0.96 [0.41, 1.59] S^-0.07 [-1.32, 1.61] (Archard: 1, 1). The TA depth rule scores a higher R² (+0.52) only because it drops the shallow part of every groove: runs at <= 25 N keep a median 11 % of their groove, runs at >= 60 N 91 %, which inflates the load exponent to 1.9; it is not a volume.

question: Which model?
verdict: COF first 10 s: final = physics law (selected ML: ANN + physics); COF end: final = physics law (selected ML: none); log10 V: final = physics law (selected ML: ANN); log10 width: final = physics law (selected ML: GPR + physics); log10 k: final = physics law (selected ML: ANN + physics).

question: Old pipeline vs final?
verdict: Replace the old pipeline. COF: the old ANN on end-of-run COF scores R² +0.40 in P1 but +0.00 on the training runs (P2); the final model on COF_first10s scores +0.36 / +0.23 with two parameters. Wear: R² -0.48 / -0.47 (ANN on mean-of-locations k, plain levelling, replicate SD 0.34 dex) -> +0.29 / +0.15 (final model on the most-worn-location volume, replicate SD 0.07 dex).

question: Does the literature data help?
verdict: Do not use the literature data: paper COF ~ L^+0.52 v^-0.69 vs ours L^-0.09 v^-0.05; log10_COF: best with paper data GPR + study flag R² +0.24 vs ours alone +0.28; log10_k: best with paper data pooled + study offset: power law R² -0.31 vs ours alone +0.41. The published COF (0.002-0.007) and volumes (up to 1620 mm³ in 200 s) are implausible as printed.

question: Can the TA script be used?
verdict: Do not use the TA script as written: 25 of 92 scans are read along the track, and the R04/R14/R20 replicates spread 30x in k (SD 0.84 dex); fixed copy 0.13 dex, ours 0.07 dex (R14/R20 only). Archard R² (P1): original -0.03, fixed -0.19, ours +0.29.
